title: GhostBulb
description: Mod that provides survival friendly invisible alternatives to items.
body:
GhostBulb

The mod provides survival friendly, expanded and integrated invisible alternatives to items such as: light block, item frame. Depends on AbstractedUtilities
Polymer patch can be found here: GitLab

Mini-Guide

In order to get the recipes and actually craft invisible items you need to get the Ghost Shard:
  • Get any naturally spawned hostile mob.
  • Gently damage this mob until it's almost dead.
  • Heal it and repeat until this entity endured damage of max hp x2 (by default).
  • Make sure current time is night.
  • Kill the hostile mob.
  • Profit.
